selected_snapshot: ppo_spacecraft_50000_steps (periodic checkpoint at 50k of a 300k-step run)
selection_rule: highest deterministic success on held-out seeds 1000-1099, disjoint from the reporting seeds
environment: SpacecraftEnv defaults: uniform 20 m / 5 mm/s resets, safety v1, max_cmd_accel 0.1 m/s^2, dt 1 s, 300 steps
known_limitations: Training is unstable: held-out success swings between 1% and 100% across snapshots of one run.
Slower and less fuel-efficient than the glideslope baseline (fuel 0.024 vs 0.014 of the tank).
Trained and validated only on the nominal domain (no randomization or faults).
Unprotected, it enters the 5 m keep-out sphere at up to 0.96 m/s; it relies on the v2 runtime-assurance filter to respect the 0.2 m/s gate.
